tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Karibu, kiongozi kijana. Mimi ni Sensei Hoshi. Ukoo wetu umepata bonde lililofichwa milimani. Tujenge kijiji ambacho hakuna mpinzani atakayekipata.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Kiwanda chako cha Sarafu kinatengeneza Sarafu. Sarafu ikielea juu yake, igonge, kisha Kusanya.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Ukoo unaendeshwa kwa Sarafu. Gonga Jenga na uweke Kiwanda cha Sarafu.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Sasa imarisha Ngome ya Ukoo: gonga kasri, kisha Boresha.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Maboresho huchukua muda. Ngome itakuwa tayari baada ya {time}: rudi wakati huo, au gonga Maliza sasa kutumia Jade kidogo.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Koo pinzani zitatuvamia. Jenga Mnara wa Kunai karibu na Ngome (Jenga, kisha kichupo cha Ulinzi): unampiga risasi mvamizi yeyote aliye karibu.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Jenga Dojo ya Mafunzo, Uwanja wa Kikosi na Mnara wa Kunai karibu na Ngome (Jenga: kichupo cha Jeshi, kisha kichupo cha Ulinzi).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Fungua paneli ya Jeshi na ufunze Shinobi kadhaa: wapiganaji wepesi wa upanga wanaoshambulia jengo lililo karibu zaidi.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Mafunzo nayo huchukua muda: wapiganaji wako watakuwa tayari baada ya {time}. Subiri, au gonga Maliza mafunzo kutumia Jade kidogo.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Uvamizi wako wa kwanza. Gonga Shambulia, kagua lengo, kisha Shambulia! Uwanjani nitakuonyesha jambo moja kwa wakati: tuma Shinobi wako kupitia kituo kinachong'aa, kisha uwafunike kwa moshi wanapofika kwenye mnara: wapiganaji walio ndani ya moshi wanaweza kupigwa tu kutoka karibu.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Umepigana vizuri. Boresha Dojo ya Mafunzo ili kufungua Wahujumu: wanakwamisha ulinzi kwa sekunde chache. Kwamisha kwanza, kisha shambulia, na ufunike wapiganaji wako kwa moshi pale moto ulipo mkali zaidi. Kusanya, boresha, vamia, na ujiunge na Muungano.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Zawadi moja kwa siku, ile ile kwa kila mtu, kamwe si ya bahati nasibu na kamwe haiuzwi. Ukikosa siku hakuna kinachopotea: dai linalofuata ni siku inayofuata kwenye orodha. Siku ya 28 inatoa mwonekano wa Ngome.

calendar.gotLook.text: Mwonekano mpya wa Ngome ni wako: Duka → Mwonekano.

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Ofa maalum hazijitokezi kwa wachezaji walio chini ya miaka 18. Kila kitu kwenye kichupo cha Jade kinapatikana ndani ya kikomo chako cha matumizi.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Uwasilishaji unaanza mara moja: malipo ya kwanza yanaweza kudaiwa sasa na mengine moja kila siku; kwa kununua unakubali kwamba unapoteza haki ya kughairi, kama sheria inavyoruhusu kwa maudhui ya kidijitali.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Ununuzi haupatikani kwa sasa. Jaribu tena baadaye.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Ununuzi haukufanikiwa. Ikiwa ulitozwa, utawasilishwa mara tu duka litakapothibitisha.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Kijiji hicho kilikuwa tayari na ngao.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Hakuna mpiganaji aliyepigana, kwa hiyo inahesabiwa kama mazoezi.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Unda upya kila jengo la aina hii kwa mara moja: {building}. Masafa hupiga mbali zaidi lakini kwa nguvu ndogo na hulenga kwanza wapiganaji wa nyuma; Mlipuko hupiga makundi lakini hufyatua polepole; Ulinzi huimarisha Mnara wa Upinde wa Angani, Kichomeo cha Moshi Mchungu na mitego. Wavamizi huona umbo hilo wanapopeleleza.

temper.locked.text: Ufuaji unafunguka kwenye Ngome ya Ukoo {level}.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Umefua: kila jengo la aina {building} lina umbo jipya.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Ulinzi pia hudhoofisha uponyaji, ufufuaji, ustahimilivu na kinga ya ngao za wavamizi katika kambi nzima.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Tangaza matokeo kabla ya kushambulia: ukiyafikia unabeba nyara zaidi nyumbani, ukiyakosa hubebi chochote.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Dau limekosekana: ulitangaza {stars}★, kwa hiyo hakuna nyara zilizofika nyumbani.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Kikosi chako kilibeba {pct} ya nyara. Vikosi vyenye kazi nyingi tofauti hubeba zaidi.

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.
